notes: EXAMPLE. A teacher asks a targeted question about one concept. Two of the three students have relevant grains; the third's grain is about something else entirely and should not appear in a good answer. The output is free text, so exactMatch is hopeless here and any string-equality approach will be. This case exists to force the question: how do you score an answer where there is no single correct wording? Consider also what happens to this agent when a classroom has thirty students rather than three.
